answers.core: Yes. Because necessary internals of an engine are not exposed in anyway. We can't access it thus it cannot be implemented as add-on.
answers.workaround:
Not really. Workaround would need a lot of boilerplate especially since you need to handle both - `CollisionShape2D` and `TileMapLayer` separately.
See this old post that I found:
https://forum.godotengine.org/t/how-can-i-detect-a-tilemaplayer-tile-as-one-way-using-a-raycast/77787
There is a workaround proposed but only for `TileMapLayer` and it's overly complicated.
And even if the one-way property was exposed we would need multiple casting to exclude all the one-way shapes one by one. It would impact performance.
